equipment.notes: Three-way horizontal midfield: 7" and 4" honeycomb woofers and a HEDD AMT tweeter, 3 x 300 W ICEpower class D, 32 Hz to 40 kHz, crossovers at 250 Hz and 3.2 kHz, 120 dB max SPL per pair at 1 m. Sold as mirrored Left and Right cabinets with the same connections; one entry per cabinet, so place two for a stereo pair. The AES input loops out to the next cabinet, so a pair can run from one AES feed. Power draw is not published: HEDD quote amplifier power and an 85-264 V input range, not consumption.
